name: fix_github_actions_least_privilege
description: Replaces an over-broad `permissions: write-all` GITHUB_TOKEN grant with a least-privilege contents:read block
prompts: The workflow .github/workflows/deploy.yml grants the GITHUB_TOKEN `permissions: write-all`, far more than it needs (it only checks out the repo and runs a script). Apply least privilege: replace the top-level `permissions: write-all` with a `permissions:` mapping that grants only `contents: read` (no scope should be write). Do not change the workflow `name`, the `on:` triggers, or the `jobs`.

setup_files..github/workflows/deploy.yml:
name: Deploy
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
permissions: write-all
jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: ./deploy.sh

test_setup_files.test_perms.py:
import yaml

with open('.github/workflows/deploy.yml') as f:
    wf = yaml.safe_load(f)

perms = wf.get('permissions')
assert perms is not None, 'no top-level permissions block'
assert perms != 'write-all', 'permissions is still write-all (over-broad)'
assert isinstance(perms, dict), f'permissions should be a mapping of scopes, got {perms!r}'
assert perms.get('contents') == 'read', f"contents should be 'read', got {perms.get('contents')!r}"
writes = [k for k, v in perms.items() if v == 'write']
assert not writes, f'a read-only workflow should grant no write scopes: {writes}'

# unchanged structure
assert wf.get('name') == 'Deploy', 'workflow name changed'
on = wf.get('on') or wf.get(True)
assert on, 'on: triggers removed'
assert 'deploy' in wf.get('jobs', {}), 'deploy job removed'

print('PASS')

reference_solution..github/workflows/deploy.yml:
name: Deploy
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: ./deploy.sh
